guidance.heading: FOURTH QUARTER 2026 OUTLOOK & GUIDANCE
section: Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, which has four fewer shipping days versus the prior year and three fewer shipping days versus the third quarter of the current year, the Company assumes flooring market conditions will be softer relative to the third quarter and expects low single-digit growth in adjusted net sales versus the prior year. Management also anticipates that the underlying cost of sales inflation headwind on a year-over-year basis will be similar to the third quarter and expects to fully offset this through pricing, mix and productivity. Given management's current input cost expectations and actions to date, the Company expects a similar dynamic in the first quarter of 2027. For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects adjusted EPS in the range of $1.35 to $1.45. Assumptions included in the Company’s guidance are:
•Adjusted Net Interest Expense of approximately $4 to $5 million
•Adjusted Depreciation & Amortization Expense of approximately $148 million
•Weighted Average Diluted Share Count of approximately 58.5 million
